title: AAPS only sporadically receives the BG values from XDrip. DEV-j
body:
The BG values arrive very irregularly. Sometimes a 2 hour break. A restart sometimes helps.
At XDrip, the values from the Juggluco are stable and regular.
The path directly from Juggluco to AAPS (XDrip Broadcast) also works perfectly.
I only see the problem in the DEV version. With Master there are no problems.

Also via a detour - BG values from NS to AAPS, same problem.

In addition, I found that the sync between master and follower is very unreliable.
NS BETA 15.0
V3
The BG values are synchronized irregularly.
If you use the old method (no V3), everything works very cleanly.

comments.body:
Most likely cause is xDrip+ not properly running in the background. Suggesting to double check you phone's power saving options on xDrip+. 

(Tip: Maybe check out "DON'T KILL MY APP?" on the AndroidAPS about popup)

What kind of phone do you have? For some phones you need to turn on certain
options in xdrip.

Andy

- xDrip+ (build e50dfdf-2023.05.03) reliably receiving BG and treatments from NS/V15
- AAPS 3.2.0-dev-j (lastest dev build e9971b5ec9-2023-07.15) configured BG source = xDrip+ & no syncing with NS

**Result:**
- xDrip+ receiving new BG values and treatments from Hardware Data Source "NS" every 5 mins
- _AAPS: No BG data receiving_, no activity on XDRIP+BG tab.

Checked several settings on xDrip+ and could not find anything wrong. But no BG in AAPS at all.
Looks like confirmation of this issue?

@MilosKozak Should this "test" setup work or am I missing something?
(When yes, I will get some logging from AAPS and xDrip)

I am using newer xdrip (20230608) with much older AAPS (3.2 dev from few
months ago) and broadcasting works, so maybe something changed on new dev
that is impacting receiving of broadcasts from Xdrip?

Andy

- Not syncing with NS
- BG source is xDrip+ (version 2023.07.16)
- xDrip+ is getting BG value's from my main NS

Still suspect this may be a problem with Pixel ad battery management.
Did you try disabling Google Play Protect? (it can close app's that it "thinks" are misbehaving)

You might need post a question in xdrip community...
So in beginning of year I had similar problem with OnePlus (xdrip was
receiving every 2nd reading) so OnePlus was put on special list (together
with Samsung and Redmi) of phones that have "broken" power management with
BT devices. Maybe your device needs to be put on that list too?
Andy
